messages.message: Hi! Thanks for contacting Nimbus Telecom. I'm Meera. How can I help you today? 😊
I'm so annoyed. My bill is way higher than it should be this month. This is ridiculous!
I'm sorry to hear that you're frustrated with your bill. I'll do my best to get this sorted for you. Can I start by getting your account number and date of birth please?
Fine. Account number is 11894083 and my DOB is 01/01/1968.
Thank you, Rohan Iyer. I'm looking at your account now. I see a charge for a premium data package that you didn't request. My apologies for the error.
Exactly! I never signed up for that. If this keeps happening, I'm just going to cancel my service and switch to another provider.
I completely understand. I will raise a refund request for the wrong charge right now to get this corrected.
Just so you know, the credit is subject to approval and usually takes 7-10 business days to appear on your statement.
Okay, that works. I also need to pay the remaining balance now so it doesn't get cut off. Can I do that here?
Yes, you can. Please provide the card details you'd like to use.
It's four two four six four zero zero eight five nine nine seven nine eight seven two
My address is 78 Brigade Road and my phone is 92446 85314.
Payment processed successfully! Is there anything else I can help you with today? I've requested the refund for the overcharge, which you'll see in 7-10 business days. Goodbye!
No, that's all. Thanks for fixing it so quickly, Meera! 😊
